items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I never met him, I always appreciate his outrageous sense of humor.

ctx.x: It’s the insanity of that. And my father-in-law knows, one of his good friends, I can’t remember if it’s Earl Bennett or not — actually also played with Spike Jones and said it © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
